items.questionEn: What is the main difference between PRM and PAM?

options.text: PRM defines process expectations; PAM assesses process capability
PRM defines ratings; PAM defines project schedules
PRM manages work products; PAM creates software requirements
PRM is only for safety; PAM is only for software

items.explanationVi: PRM mô tả process cần đạt gì; PAM cung cấp model để đánh giá process được thực hiện tốt đến mức nào.

items.questionEn: What does the process dimension identify in an assessment?

options.text: The capability level achieved
Which process is being assessed
The project budget
The number of work products

items.explanationVi: Process dimension xác định đang đánh giá process nào; capability dimension xác định process đó đạt capability ở mức nào.

options.text: Whether the process is performed and achieves its outcomes
Whether organizational processes are deployed
Whether work products are controlled
Whether the process is formally defined at organization level

items.explanationVi: PA1.1 là Process Performance: kiểm tra process có được thực hiện và đạt process outcomes hay không.

items.questionEn: What is the focus of PA2.1?

options.text: Defining the organizational process
Managing process performance through planning, monitoring, and adjustment
Deploying the process into a project
Determining the process scope

items.explanationVi: PA2.1 là Performance Management: tập trung vào planning, monitoring và adjustment của process performance.

options.text: Whether work products are appropriately managed and controlled
Whether process outcomes exist
Whether the organization has a defined process
Whether a capability level is requested by the customer

items.explanationVi: PA2.2 là Work Product Management: tập trung vào việc quản lý và kiểm soát work products.

options.text: Whether a defined process is established at organizational level
Whether the process is performed once
Whether work products are reviewed
Whether evidence has been sampled

items.explanationVi: PA3.1 là Process Definition: kiểm tra organization có process chuẩn được định nghĩa hay chưa.

options.text: Whether the defined process is deployed in the project or environment
Whether the process achieves its first outcome
Whether work products are controlled
Whether the assessment uses sampling

items.explanationVi: PA3.2 là Process Deployment: kiểm tra process chuẩn có thực sự được triển khai vào project hoặc environment hay không.

items.questionEn: What does the rating 'F' mean in N/P/L/F?

options.text: Fully achieved
Functionally defined
Formally reviewed
Fully documented

items.explanationVi: F = Fully achieved. N/P/L/F lần lượt là Not, Partially, Largely và Fully achieved.

items.questionEn: Which PA rating combination is required for CL2?

options.text: PA1.1 = F; PA2.1 and PA2.2 = L or F
PA1.1 = L; PA2.1 and PA2.2 = P
PA1.1, PA2.1, PA2.2 all = P

items.explanationVi: Theo capability rules trong source: CL2 cần PA1.1 = F và PA2.1, PA2.2 đạt L hoặc F.

items.questionEn: Which combination is required for CL3?

options.text: PA1.1, PA2.1, PA2.2 = F; PA3.1 and PA3.2 = L or F
PA1.1 = L; all other PAs = P
PA1.1 = F; PA2.1 and PA2.2 = P
Only PA3.1 and PA3.2 must be F

items.explanationVi: CL3 cần PA1.1, PA2.1, PA2.2 = F; PA3.1 và PA3.2 phải đạt L hoặc F.

items.questionEn: What is the correct assessment flow?

options.text: Scope → Sampling → Evidence → Rating → Aggregate → Capability → Gap
Capability → Scope → Rating → Evidence → Sampling
Gap → Capability → Scope → Evidence → Rating
Rating → Capability → Scope → Sampling → Evidence

items.explanationVi: Luồng cốt lõi: xác định scope, sampling, thu evidence, rating, aggregate rồi xác định capability và gap.

items.questionEn: Which statement about evidence is correct?

options.text: Having a document automatically proves the process is achieved
Evidence should be relevant, objective, sufficient, consistent, and traceable
An interview statement is always sufficient evidence
Evidence is not needed when a process is documented

items.explanationVi: Evidence không chỉ là có document. Evidence cần phù hợp, khách quan, đủ, nhất quán, traceable và phản ánh implementation thực tế.
